calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when recent 10-day weakness and low location within their own 40-day high-low range suggest rebound potential; scales by 40-day realized volatility and lags one completed session.

validation.regime_notes: 10D IC by available regime: 2026-2029 0.097801 (887 dates), 2030-2032 0.023376 (784), 2033-2035 0.019950 (593). Earlier dates unavailable in the returned aligned history. Positive at 10D and 40D in all available regimes; uncertainty is material given 15 assets.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC between lagged signal and forward close-to-close returns; dates require at least 8 valid instruments.
